# gitGraph fixtures

- `docs-basic.mmd`, `docs-commit-types.mmd`, `docs-cherry-pick.mmd`: examples
  from the Mermaid gitGraph documentation
  (https://mermaid.js.org/syntax/gitgraph.html), MIT licensed,
  © Knut Sveidqvist and contributors.
- `merge-tags.mmd`: the mermaid-svg 0.7.0 sample
  (https://github.com/xmiksay/mermaid/tree/v0.7.0/samples), MIT licensed.
- `tb-order-cjk.mmd`, `bt-parallel.mmd`: written for this crate: `TB:` and
  `BT:`, branch `order`, CJK names, `switch`, `parallelCommits` and
  `mainBranchName`.
